subject: Data residency and retention controls: Q&A and implementation options
messages:
From: Aurelia Tran <aurelia.tran@finsecure.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@finsecure.io
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on data residency, retention and deletion controls

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the demo last week — FinSecure liked the latency/cost profile on the demo models. Before we move to a POC we need to confirm a few data residency and retention items for our security/compliance team. High-level asks below; I attached our DPA requirements (FinSecure_DPA_requirements.pdf).

Key questions:
- Can Redwood guarantee physical storage in a single cloud region per tenant (we need AWS us-west-2 only)?
- Can retention be set per-tenant (we need a 13-month retention, then permanent delete with verifiable deletion events)?
- What is the deletion SLA (time from API delete call to data being removed from hot and cold stores)?
- Can audit logs (deletion events, key access, and object location) be exported to our S3 or fed into an external SIEM?
- Any existing customers with the same requirements (preferably in finance)?

We are trying to finalize a procurement timeline this quarter. Would appreciate a short write-up of options and an estimated delivery window if changes are needed on Redwood's side.

Thanks,
Aurelia Tran
Head of Security Operations | FinSecure
Aurelia.tran@finsecure.io

I'll aim to get a customer-facing note with 2–3 options (hosted with region pinning, Dedicated reserved capacity, Private VPC appliance) and an estimated timeline by EOD Monday. Are you available Monday 11am PT for a quick 30-min sync?

Subject: Fwd: FinSecure DPA questions — actionable roadmap ask

Team — forwarding Aurelia's DPA questions. Summary of what FinSecure needs and suggested implementation approaches below. Please reply with risks/estimates. Attaching a CSV with the retention scenarios they provided (retention_requirements.csv).

Customer asks (must-haves):
- Storage locality: tenant data stored only in AWS us-west-2 (no replication to other regions).
- Per-tenant retention policy: configurable months, with irreversible purge after retention period and a verifiable deletion event per object.
- Deletion SLA: target <= 24 hours from API deletion request to complete logical + physical purge on hot tier; full cold-store purge (object-level) within 72 hours.
- Audit/export: stream deletion and object-location events to customer S3 or syslog/SIEM; include timestamp + action + storage-region + KMS-key-id.

Proposed implementation options (technical):
1) Hosted Region-Pinned Mode (low lift, medium risk)
   - Allow tenant config: storage_region = us-west-2. Data placed on region-labeled object stores.
   - Implement retention metadata at object level and augment garbage-collector to honor retention window and emit audit events.
   - Deletion pipeline: API -> tombstone message to regional SQS -> GC worker purges hot cache + enqueues cold-store purges; emit signed event.
   - Open questions: cross-region backups (we currently have infra-level snapshots for DR). Need to design DR exceptions for customers that require strict single-region residency.
   - Rough effort: 6 engineer-weeks for MVP, plus 2 weeks infra QA.

2) Dedicated tenant-reservation (recommended interim)
   - Provision a dedicated capacity pool in us-west-2, isolated storage, stricter controls for backups and snapshots.
   - Shorter timeline (3–4 weeks for sales provisioning path) but higher cost; good short-term for procurement.

3) Private (VPC/on-prem) full control (longer-term)
   - Deploy private control-plane or on-prem package with customer-managed storage and KMS.
   - Effort: variable; enterprise licensing negotiation.

Compliance pieces to deliver:
- Signed deletion events (JSON with timestamp + object id + sha256 + KMS-key-id) stored for customer and in our audit log.
- Admin console option to set per-tenant retention windows and storage_region.
- Clear documentation + sample SIEM config and S3 export playbook.

Risks / blockers:
- DR backups currently replicated across two regions by default — we need a policy/implementation to either turn off cross-region snapshots for pinned tenants or provide encrypted-at-rest snapshots that never leave the region.
- Quantization/cache layers that store prefixes may appear in ephemeral compute outside region — need to ensure compute also occurs in-region or that no customer data leaves the pinned region in plaintext.

Can you each:
- Priyom: sketch the minimal data-path changes and GC worker changes with estimate (M/W)
- Lauren: propose a customer-facing set of 2 options + pricing delta (hosted pinned vs dedicated) and a draft timeline for the customer note
- Evelyn: anything on SOC2 / audit proofing we should include before we claim compliance?

Thanks — feel free to reply inline.

--
Nikhil

Subject: Re: Fwd: FinSecure DPA questions — actionable roadmap ask

Quick notes from engineering perspective:
- Storage locality: we can tag tenant objects with a region and ensure object writes use us-west-2 buckets. Work: modify object-store client and provisioning to accept tenant.storage_region. Estimate: 2 engineer-weeks (one backend eng + infra support) for MVP.
- Deletion pipeline: current GC is eventual. We can add a prioritized tombstone queue for "pinned" tenants with SLA guarantees. Need to introduce signed deletion events and retention metadata. Estimate: 3 engineer-weeks.
- Backups/DR: snapshots are currently replicated. To meet strict single-region requirement we need to do either: (a) per-tenant no-replication snapshot policy, or (b) encrypt snapshots with customer-managed CMK and keep only in-region copies. Option (a) requires infra change and DR review. Estimate: 2 weeks.
- Compute locality: inference containers currently schedule to region pools. We'll need scheduler guardrails to prefer/us-only region pools for pinned tenants. Minor change: ~1 week.

Total low-risk MVP: ~8 engineer-weeks across 3 owners. With parallel work we could delivery an internal prototype in 6 weeks and an inbound customer-facing rollout in ~10–12 weeks with QA and legal review.

I'll attach a short ops diagram to the internal doc.

--
Priyom
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinSecure DPA questions — actionable roadmap ask

Thanks Priyom — this is helpful. For customer comms I propose:

Option A (short-term / procurement-friendly): Dedicated pool in us-west-2
- Timeline: can provision in 3–4 weeks for POC.
- Guarantees: isolated storage + capacity; we can deliver signed deletion events and S3 export immediately.
- Tradeoffs: higher monthly cost; procurement-friendly since we can provide SLA and dedicated controls.

Option B (MVP Hosted region-pinned):
- Timeline: prototype 6 weeks, GA 10–12 weeks.
- Guarantees: logical region pinning, per-tenant retention control, deletion events; need to confirm DR snapshot policy and compute locality.
- Tradeoffs: needs infra and scheduler changes (Priyom's estimates).

Mitigations while roadmap work is in flight:
- Offer an interim Dedicated environment for FinSecure to meet procurement deadlines.
- Provide documented playbook for SIEM/S3 export and signed deletion events for audit.

Next steps before I respond to Aurelia:
1) Confirm whether compute must remain in-region for the POC (Aurelia's answer will change timelines).
2) Legal/Evelyn: confirm what we can commit to in writing re: snapshot replication and proof-of-deletion format.
3) Pricing: I'll draft a brief comparison with ballpark pricing delta and a recommended POC path.

If you're all aligned I'm happy to draft the customer note and propose the Monday 11am PT call Nikhil suggested (or move it).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product — Redwood Inference

Hi Aurelia — thanks again for the clear list and the DPA. Internal alignment completed; summarizing options so you can pick the procurement-friendly path: 

Short summary of options we can provide:
1) Dedicated pool in AWS us-west-2 (recommended for procurement)
   - Timeline for POC: 3–4 weeks to provision and hand over to your ops team.
   - Guarantees: dedicated storage in us-west-2, signed deletion events, immediate S3 export for audit. Higher cost but fastest route.

2) Hosted region-pinned (MVP -> GA)
   - Timeline: prototype in ~6 weeks, GA ~10–12 weeks (we'll prioritize FinSecure as a launch partner).
   - Guarantees: per-tenant retention setting, region-labeled object store, deletion pipeline with signed events. Need to finalize DR snapshot behavior and compute locality.

Compliance deliverables we will include for both options:
- Signed deletion event payloads (JSON with timestamp, object id, sha256, KMS key id).
- Ability to push audit events to your S3 bucket or a SIEM endpoint.
- A playbook covering S3 export, sample queries for verification, and a runbook for support escalations.

Questions for you so we can finalize proposal:
- Do you require inference compute to also remain in us-west-2 for the POC?
- Are you okay starting with Dedicated for the POC and moving to hosted pinned once GA is ready?

If that works, we'll send a short commercial addendum for Dedicated pricing and target a 30-min POC kickoff. Attached is a draft residency roadmap and the DPA you provided (redwood-residency-roadmap-draft.pdf).

Best,
